directory_policies.notes.6: GPA policy: Applicants may submit their original grading scale; below-3.0 exceptions need justification. Exact GPA scope and applicable exceptions remain under review.
directory_policies.notes.7: English policy: Scores expire after two years; the department tests validity at June 15 for fall and November 15 before spring. An assessment-date check cannot substitute for those anchors.

source_excerpt: English test scores expire two years
fact_summary: The FAQ distinguishes original GPA scales, exceptional review and fixed seasonal English-expiration anchors; no automatic GPA conversion or validity pass is inferred.
